record.coOperativeRequirementsUndergraduate:
1. Complete a minimum of four credited work terms.
    1. A minimum of three must be standard work terms.
  2. Complete a total of four Professional Development (PD) courses:
    1. PD1: Must be completed in the term prior to the first work term.
    2. PD12: Must be completed during the first work term.
    3. Two additional PD courses: To be taken during each work term until the requirement is complete.

Notes

  1. Students who have attempted to secure employment for all four available work terms, but are successful in doing so for only three work terms, may be considered for a co-op degree, provided they have received credit for all three of their work terms, and they have successfully completed all academic requirements. This decision is at the discretion of the School of Accounting and Finance, Co-operative Education, and the Faculty of Arts Examinations and Standings (E&S) Committee.
  2. Students are required to follow only prescribed study/work-term sequencing options through to graduation.
  3. Students who meet all the academic requirements for this plan, but who do not meet the minimum requirements for a co-op degree may, in exceptional circumstances and at the discretion of the School of Accounting and Finance and the Faculty of Arts Examinations and Standings (E&S) Committee, be awarded a regular Honours Accounting and Financial Management degree.

record.title: Accounting and Financial Management (Bachelor of Accounting and Financial Management - Honours)
record.admissionRequirements: Students normally apply for direct admission from high school to the first year of the Accounting and Financial Management program. Upon completing a provisional first year (maintaining a minimum 70% major cumulative average in the required 100-level courses taken during 1A and 1B), students will formally proceed into the Accounting and Financial Management program in second year.
record.minimumAverageSRequired:
• A minimum cumulative overall average of 60.0%.
  • A minimum cumulative major average of 70.0% from all the required courses listed below, all AFM courses, all SFM courses, and all courses included in the AFM specializations.
record.specializationDetails: Students must complete one of the five available specializations and may elect to complete a second.
record.graduationRequirements:
Unit Requirements

  • Complete a total of 20.0 units:
    • Complete 13.5 units of required courses.
    • Complete 2.5-3.0 units by completing the required courses for one specialization.
    • Complete 3.5-4.0 units of elective courses.

Undergraduate Communication Requirement

All students must meet the Undergraduate Communication Requirement by successfully completing AFM111 and COMMST111.
